  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Golang software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience developing for Ubuntu Linux
  • Experience with Juju, LXD, Microk8s, Snapd, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer

We offer a distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person, a personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year, annual compensation review, recognition rewards, annual holiday leave, maternity and paternity leave, Employee Assistance Program, opportunities to travel to new locations, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

description:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar atendimento comercial da carteira de representantes local, promovendo relacionamento, treinamentos, acompanhamento de vendas, promovendo iniciativas geradoras de venda, gestão comercial etc.;
  • Administrar carteira de clientes;
  • Apoiar na rotina comercial dos pontos de vendas;
  • Garantir a retenção de clientes e prospecção de novos pontos de vendas;
  • Auxiliar nas negociações e fechamentos de vendas
  • Focar na expansão da carteira de representantes através da nomeação de novos parceiros: prospecção, seleção, treinamento, ativação etc.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior completo;
  • Habilidades: Boa comunicação, Pro atividade, Gestão Comercial; Prospecção de novos parceiros;
  • Conhecimento obrigatório: Pacote Office intermediário, Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Conhecimento diferencial: Experiência comercial com vendas externas no mercado de consórcio.

Local de trabalho:

Rio de Janeiro - Norte Fluminense

Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido

Benefícios pra você!

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados;
  • Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Sessões de psicoterapia
  • Tá afim de fazer o bem? Aqui na Rodobens proporcionamos oportunidades de participar em váriasações de voluntariado

De segunda a sexta-feira, 8h as 18h, com 1h de almoço.

SER O PARCEIRO DO PRÓXIMO PASSO DA SUA CARREIRA!

Com mais de 70 anos de existência, a Rodobens vem trazendo soluções financeiras para empresas e pessoas, contemplando suas necessidades de acordo com cada processo. Tem sede em São José do Rio Preto/SP, com presença em todo o território nacional, possui uma sólida cultura de inovação e tradição ao entregar às pessoas clientes, fornecedoras, colaboradoras e parceiras uma experiência completa. ????

Somos especialistas em projetos de vida e possuímos uma plataforma de serviços financeiros, alavancada em um ecossistema de varejo automotivo, que distribui produtos e serviços em mais de 3.300 pontos de venda em todo o Brasil, combinando canais físicos e digitais , próprios e de parceiros.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - AppArmor role at Canonical

As the most widely used Linux distribution, Ubuntu underpins the security of the entire internet. The role of Security Engineering Manager directly impacts the safety and security of millions of users worldwide. Join a team of security experts dedicated to protecting the open-source ecosystem and driving innovation. Your leadership will be instrumental in addressing emerging threats, developing robust security measures, and ensuring the continued integrity of Ubuntu. This is an opportunity to make a tangible difference and leave a lasting legacy on the digital landscape.

The AppArmor team's first responsibility is to develop security features and capabilities for AppArmor, the security module protecting all Ubuntu users, by providing mandatory access control to confine programs and restrict their access to system resources.Your work will improve the security of millions of people. You will engage directly with our community and customers, as well as coordinating efforts across multiple engineering teams and projects to make this happen.

An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.

What you will do in this role

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the security engineering leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Proficient in C and have a good understanding of Linux kernel development
  • Experience working with Linux Security Modules
  • Knowledgeable and passionate about software and application security
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • A demonstrated drive for continual learning
  • Builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Optional things we value

  • Good understanding of containers/packaging formats

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior maintenance engineer rotating equipment
description:
Overview

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the clients Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shapes remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.

We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.

Responsibilities
  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate integrally with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shapes remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelor\'s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.
Differentials
  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.

  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.

description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our regional Support Managers run world-class Support teams – solving deep technical problems for customers around the world on Ubuntu Server, Ubuntu Desktop and on the public cloud. They demonstrate two key attributes: customer focus – ensuring that customers are always satisfied with the service they are receiving, and technical excellence – ensuring that the support team is always up to date with the our technology, and that they perform sound and quick troubleshooting. We are looking for managers for both of our support groups; Cloud Support Group and Devices Support Group.

You'll need to be comfortable in a fast paced environment, able to take responsibility for delivering to customers and enjoy challenges. You will also need to care deeply about your team, their skills, and their career development.

The role entails

  • Management of a professional support team, including skills development and performance management
  • Operational control, shift scheduling, accountability for key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Ensures that all customer cases are responded to within the SLA, and in a professional manner
  • Act as the customer escalation contact, and ensure that such escalations are addressed appropriately
  • Accountability for customer satisfaction
  • Contribution to the support knowledge base
  • Continuous improvement to the team's processes and support service delivery
  • Hire, develop and train support team to match business requirements
  • Work with the leadership team to drive growth and transformation initiatives

What are we looking for in you

  • Extensive CLI experience with Linux at a technical level (Support, Development, Implementation)
  • Leadership experience, and preferably team management experience
  • Confidence under pressure, with proven track record of high customer focus
  • Preferably fluent in two languages, English being primary one
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Experience or knowledge of Linux Desktop, OpenStack, Public Cloud or Virtualization technologies
  • Proven track record of contributing to Open Source projects
  • Software development experience
  • Experience in working in support organizations
  • Hands on experience with Canonical's products

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Associate – Global Mobility Tax
description:

We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

As a Senior Associate, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive tax and consulting experience, helping clients meet their individual income tax compliance obligations. You will address complex tax issues from strategy to execution, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting clients in their individual income tax compliance obligations, including preparation of individual income tax computations and returns, and handling correspondence with the respective tax authorities.

  • Coaching others and encouraging them to take ownership of their development.

  • Developing a perspective on key global trends, including globalization, and how they impact the company and our clients.
  • Managing a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
  • Focusing on building trusted relationships.
  • Upholding the company's code of ethics and business conduct.
Qualifications

Requirements include:

  • Interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
  • Demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard.
  • Experience in expatriate tax.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience for senior position.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, clients, and staff.
  • Strong analytical, organization, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education/Graduation: Business, Law, Economy, International Relations.
  • Demonstrated business development skills and enthusiasm about contributing to the growth of the Global Mobility Services practice.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop.

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better!

Location : we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

  • Professional written and spoken English

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability

Nice-to-have skills we would value

  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Senior Product Engineer - Americas
description:
Overview

Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as individual contributors—where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

We believe in ownership and autonomy, with engineers taking end-to-end responsibility for projects. You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. Examples of how product engineers at Ashby contribute include:

  • Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app.
  • Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
  • Spec’d, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby.
What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. TA software didn’t help. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling.

We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Software engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some things to help you decide if this fits you and what you’re looking for:

  • You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure.
  • You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity and thrive at the intersection of the two.
  • You know how to balance speed and quality. We moved with urgency, while delivering a high-quality product that encouraged customer adoption.
  • You’re ambitious and open to feedback to level up.
  • You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator and can work with stakeholders to ship products.
  • You seek to create leverage in your work through automation and abstractions.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You view tech leads or principals as project managers and require sign-offs.
  • You need company-wide processes to drive your projects.
  • You only want exciting work and dislike customer issues and investigations being distributed across the team.
  • You get lost in details and prefer everything planned upfront.
  • You haven’t led or owned projects before.
  • You want to mentor many junior engineers; our team is largely senior and mentorship opportunities are limited.
Engineering Culture

Our culture is grounded in ownership and collaboration. We aim for a small, talented team that can ship high-quality software fast and maintain reasonable work hours. We focus on:

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
  • Building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers deliver magical outcomes with minimal oversight while keeping stakeholders informed. We prefer engineers who own their problems end-to-end rather than rely on heavy processes.

Technology Stack

TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis. Experience with these is not required, but a love of typed languages helps. Engineers who have switched from other languages are welcome; what matters is fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.

Benefits

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget
  • $100/month education budget
  • Health insurance for you and dependents (fully covered by Ashby in the US; in other countries, high-quality supplemental insurance is provided)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

  • Develop OSINT tradecraft, principals, and techniques
  • Identify and track targeted intrusion cyber threats, trends, and new developments by cyber threat actors through analysis of proprietary and open source datasets
  • Collaborate across teams to inform on activity of interest
  • Coordinate adversary/campaign tracking
  • Contribute to the wider threat intelligence community, establishing Canonical as a key contributor and thought leader in the space
  • Work with product and engineering teams to explain cybersecurity threats and advise on mitigation strategies
  • Work with the OPSEC and IS team to help implement/update security controls prioritising cyber defence
  • Identify intelligence gaps and propose new tools and research projects to fill them
  • Conduct briefings for executives, internal stakeholders and external customers

The successful Threat Intelligence Lead will be

  • An experienced threat intelligence leader (or similar)
  • Knowledgeable about the current open source threat landscape and computer networking/infrastructure concepts
  • Highly competent with OSINT tools (e.g., Buscador, Trace Labs OSINT VM, OSINT Framework, Maltego, Shodan, social media scraping tools, etc.)
  • Able to identify, organise, catalogue, and track adversary tradecraft trends — often with incomplete data
  • Experienced using threat intelligence data to influence enterprise architecture or product development decisions
  • An excellent communicator with the ability to clearly articulate and tailor technical content to a variety of audiences
  • Able to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Desired Characteristics

  • A professional portfolio of OSINT related scripts, tools, or frameworks
  • Demonstrated involvement in the larger OSINT community (please share relevant links)
  • Degree qualified, with a bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, or a related field
  • Certifications in related areas (e.g. GOSI, SANS SEC487 & SEC587, IntelTechniques OSIP, etc)
  • Experience in a tech company or government/military signal intelligence departments

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O titular do cargo atua em um ambiente multidisciplinar de contratos e compras (exploração, perfuração, desenvolvimento, trabalho no mar e em terra) em um ambiente internacional e ambiente de conteúdo local simultaneamente.

A falta ou entrega tardia de materiais ou serviços, independentemente de seu valor, pode ter consequências importantes na produção e nas finanças.

Atividades

O(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), alinhado aos Princípios do One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, tendo em mente a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para melhorar a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos da Empresa, bem como sua reputação.

As principais atividades do titular do cargo são:

  • Supervisionar o estabelecimento dos contratos, participando diretamente dos contratos e pedidos de compra mais complexos.
  • Validar ou garantir a validação de todos os documentos contratuais e cartas formais emitidas pela área de contratos e compras.
  • Participar de auditorias contratuais seletivas para garantir o cumprimento dos termos e condições contratuais.
  • Intervir na resolução de litígios, em conjunto com as áreas Jurídica, Seguros e Financeira, propondo estratégias e ações, e participando das negociações.
  • Definir e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para garantir a melhoria da eficiência.
  • Manter atualizados os conteúdos locais dos modelos de contrato (condições gerais e particulares), e adaptar versões internacionais às exigências locais.

  • Definir, adotar e monitorar estratégias de contratação e compras adequadas (por categorias, etc.).

  • Realizar todas as atividades de contratação em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empresa e com a legislação brasileira.
  • Definir a estratégia de contratação em conjunto com o(a) contraparte do “Dueto” para atender e proteger os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa.
  • Propor, pré-qualificar e recomendar contratantes/fornecedores adequados para listas de licitação, visando maximizar a eficiência dos processos de concorrência.
  • Compilar, emitir e administrar pacotes de “Convite para Licitação” para obter propostas realistas e comercialmente atrativas de potenciais contratantes/fornecedores. (Isso inclui revisar e compilar a parte técnica do pacote de licitação com base nas informações recebidas dos técnicos e fornecer aconselhamento comercial relevante).
  • Redigir termos e condições contratuais e comerciais apropriados para melhor atender e proteger os interesses da Empresa.
  • Revisar propostas, participar de esclarecimentos e negociações contratuais e comerciais, preparar todos os documentos associados, como apresentações, atas de reuniões, registro de qualificações contratuais e comerciais, minuta de recomendação de adjudicação, finalizar o contrato, administrar a adjudicação de contratos, ordens de mudança/variação, aditivos contratuais, reivindicações e toda a correspondência associada.
  • Revisar e considerar os aspectos legais associados à adjudicação e administração de contratos, em articulação com o Departamento Jurídico, fornecendo aconselhamento aos clientes conforme apropriado e auxiliando, quando necessário, na resolução de litígios.
  • Arquivar a documentação contratual e correspondências de forma lógica, organizada e auditável.
  • Participar da aprovação externa (Parceiros), revisando os boletins com as informações relevantes de C&P.
  • Garantir que todos os certificados contratuais, garantias, cauções e seguros exigidos no portfólio de contratos estejam em vigor dentro do prazo.
  • Facilitar reuniões necessárias para a condução das atividades do cargo.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Ativos Operados por Terceiros (OBO), participando de apresentações do Operador e assessorando nos aspectos contratuais e comerciais.

O titular do cargo gerencia a Conformidade:

  • Verificar que as Políticas de Contratos e Compras da empresa e as leis e regulamentos aplicáveis estão sendo seguidos, especialmente no que diz respeito à ética e transparência.
  • Verificar que os documentos e procedimentos de compras estão em conformidade com os padrões da empresa e com os acordos firmados com os parceiros.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o respeito aos procedimentos durante o processo de licitação.
  • Assegurar a aplicação das Condições Gerais de Compra da TEPBR, especialmente no que diz respeito a equipamentos complexos, de alto valor e alto risco.

O titular do cargo segue as regras de H3SE:

  • Servir como exemplo pessoal na adesão aos procedimentos de HSE da TEPBR.
  • Promover conscientização e fornecer orientação aos colaboradores sob sua supervisão quanto à execução das regras de HSE, tanto para funcionários da Empresa quanto para fornecedores, sem prejudicar as obrigações legais do Contratado.
  • Assegurar, para si e para os colaboradores sob sua supervisão, a segurança do ambiente de trabalho, evitando riscos às pessoas, às instalações e impactos ao meio ambiente.
  • Manter os meios de proteção individual e os procedimentos de emergência de segurança.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares e reportar quaisquer incidentes (anomalias, atos inseguros, quase acidentes, danos, derramamentos, lesões, etc.).
  • Notificar os colaboradores relevantes sobre acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes, e iniciar ações corretivas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar, negociar, adjudicar e administrar contratos/pedidos de compra de obras, bens e serviços de forma a garantir que os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa sejam atendidos e protegidos.
  • Conduzir o trabalho de maneira a otimizar o desempenho em HSEQ (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade), a reputação e a lucratividade da Empresa, em estrita conformidade com os mais altos padrões de ética empresarial.
  • Estar em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Empresa (CMS) aplicáveis ao cargo, reportando quaisquer não conformidades à gestão direta.

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

  • As regras da Empresa sejam seguidas ou devidamente justificadas em caso de exceção.
  • As Especificações Gerais, Diretrizes e Manuais sejam considerados.
  • Os indicadores e KPIs sejam observados, monitorados e devidamente reportados.
  • Os objetivos de desempenho e eficiência de custos em Contratos e Compras sejam cumpridos.
  • O conhecimento técnico em Contratos e Compras seja compartilhado dentro do grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Sejam buscadas oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
Perfil do Candidato

Competências de C&P (Contratos e Compras):

  • Competências técnicas avançadas em contratos e compras são exigidas.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado nas demais competências técnicas.

Qualificação e Experiência:

  • Formação superior (nível universitário ou acima).
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos processos de compras, incluindo: princípios éticos; pré-qualificação de licitantes; convite para licitação; avaliação comparativa de contratantes; adjudicação, gestão de reivindicações, administração, alteração e encerramento de contratos.
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência prática na preparação, negociação e administração de contratos de projetos complexos, preferencialmente na indústria de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento profissional demonstrável e compreensão de questões comerciais, jurídicas e de seguros que afetam a empresa em geral, e compreensão aprofundada quando relevante para contratos de obras, bens e serviços.
  • Conhecimento geral e compreensão das funções empresariais da empresa, com entendimento aprofundado da função de contratos e de como ela agrega valor, além de compromisso em entregar valor agregado.
  • Deve ter proficiência em inglês e fluência em português.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

Sobre a Abbott

A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.

Trabalhando na Abbott

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena.

  • Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos
  • Benefícios como Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Subsidio de Medicamentos, Desconto para compra de ações da Abbott, entre outros.
  • Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune.
  • Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas.
  • Políticas de trabalho flexíveis que permitem um equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Um ambiente onde cada pessoa é ouvida e valorizada.
Descrição de cargo
  • Gerenciar as atividades no desenvolvimento galênico e pré-formulação, garantindo o desenvolvimento de formulações e processos seguros, robustos e com seus parâmetros críticos identificados.
  • Desenvolver equipes de alta performance, promovendo o aumento do portfólio da Abbott em acordo com as normas e políticas praticadas pela Abbott e colaboração com as áreas Comerciais e de Operações.
  • Liderar as equipes, contribuindo de forma efetiva para o desenvolvimento interpessoal, aumento de performance, detecção de habilidades e pontos de melhoria para criação de uma equipe de alta performance;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, caracterizações (ex.: polimorfismo, PSD, compatibilidade, etc), formulações e processos de fabricação garantindo o aumento do portfólio da empresa em acordo com o plano comercial da Abbott;
  • Liderar as equipes de pré-formulação e Galênico na condução do desenvolvimento de novos produtos através de um processo racional e padronizado de desenvolvimento, baseado em ciência e investigação, visando sempre a qualidade no processo de desenvolvimento para mitigar problemas na rotina futura, usando conceitos de “Quality by Design” e “DoE” e “PAT”;
  • Liderar projetos de nível global e regional, participando dede forma ativa em reuniões, discussões e tomadas de decisões;
  • Garantir que todas as etapas de desenvolvimento de um novo produto de forma que as informações necessárias estejam presentes em documentos padronizados e oficiais;
  • Garantir a realização dos estudos de pré-formulação de IFAs (insumo farmacêutico ativo), excipientes, fórmulas e processos através de técnicas analíticas avançadas, suportada por pesquisas bibliográficas, estudos de artigos e estudos de patentes;
  • Suportar e liderar os pesquisadores a identificar, registrar e monitorar parâmetros e pontos críticos do processo e do produto, para que descrevam nos relatórios de desenvolvimento todo o racional desde o início das etapas de desenvolvimento;

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.
Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;

description:
Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de dados senior role at Netvagas

Na Zerezes, acreditamos que bons dados transformam decisões em impacto real. Buscamos uma pessoa engenheira de dados para fortalecer nossa estrutura analítica e acelerar a construção de uma fundação robusta, acessível e confiável para os dados que impulsionam o negócio.

Hoje, operamos com pipelines construídos em Lambdas agendadas, que integram, filtram e transformam dados vindos de diferentes fontes (MySQL, MongoDB, APIs) e os consolidam em um banco MySQL, consumido via Metabase. Estamos evoluindo para uma arquitetura mais escalável e flexível, com ferramentas como Airflow, AWS Glue e, no futuro, um Data Lake com curadoria, governança e análise em larga escala.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis (ETL/ELT), hoje com AWS Lambda e, futuramente, com Airflow, Glue e arquitetura baseada em Data Lake.

  • Integrar fontes de dados diversas (APIs, bancos relacionais, NoSQL).

  • Colaborar com áreas como Produto, Marketing e Vendas para entregar soluções analíticas eficazes.
  • Participar da evolução arquitetural da área de dados, propondo melhorias contínuas e novas abordagens técnicas.

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Programação em Python (preferencialmente).

  • Familiaridade com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, preferencialmente).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de BI (Metabase ou similares).
  • Noções sólidas de governança e segurança de dados.
  • Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis.
Requisitos desejáveis
  • Experiência com Athena ou outras soluções de data warehouse na nuvem.
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Airflow, Glue, Spark.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) especialmente com Terraform ou AWS CDK.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

This is a general track for Senior+ (Senior/Staff/Principal) Engineers in any team at Canonical. After the first round of interviews we will establish which teams might be an excellent fit, and progress your application with them.

At Canonical a Senior+ Engineer is not only an outstanding software architect and coder, they also demonstrate the leadership qualities needed to rally a team or department to ship outstanding products. A Senior+ Engineer partners with other Engineering leaders (Managers, Directors, VPs) to take joint responsibility for outcomes at team, department and company level. We hire based on academic results and proven execution, and we select those with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will make a significant contribution in Canonical's portfolio through high-quality code, technical leadership, team motivation and direction, exceptional design, and crisp documentation.

As a Senior+ Engineer you'll drive the architecture, design and evolution of high-impact open source software. Our teams work at every level of the stack. From the kernel and system software at the core of Ubuntu through to major language runtimes and the bleeding-edge of cloud automation and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex but highly rewarding projects. Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: we have remote opportunities for Senior Engineers in every time zone.

The role entails

  • Leading design and architecture of an impactful open source project
  • Coding in Golang, Rust, Python, C/C++ or Typescript / React
  • Collaborating proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring, developing and advising colleagues in their career progression
  • Displaying technical leadership in Canonical and our communities
  • Debugging issues and producing high-quality code to fix them
  • Contributing to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
  • Working from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Technical leadership as well as team motivation, direction and pace
  • Deep experience with at least one of Go, Rust, Python or C
  • Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
  • Excellent communication skills including professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

Depending on your eventual team, you might also bring experience with

  • Container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Highly concurrent, distributed systems
  • Performance engineering – from kernel to web – benchmarks, optimization
  • Software security – fuzzing, tabletop threat models, analysis, audit
  • Build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Public clouds or OpenStack
  • Debian/Ubuntu packaging
  • Systems programming or scalable web services
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front-end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience

title: Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Server - cloud-init
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Ubuntu Server is the world’s most popular Linux distribution for cloud and bare metal. In this role, you will manage the team delivering cloud-init – the standard for customizing cloud instances – to the world.

Cloud-init supports various distributions and underlying platforms. This provides an opportunity to work with cloud providers to add features and integrations, the cloud-init community, and distributions to update builds and coordinate needs. You will own the product, influence its evolution, and interact with many teams and partners to coordinate new features, enhancements, and integration into various platforms.

The successful applicant will be passionate about the future of cloud-init, mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and aware of the needs of large, innovative customers. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader who values strong teams, open source software, and Ubuntu.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. We recruit on a global basis and operate with a distributed team across 75+ countries.

What you'll do
  • Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Work with Product Management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu and your team
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders
  • Participate in strong engineering processes through code and architectural reviews
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community, and commercial partners
  • Oversee the quality of the Ubuntu Server image family
  • Plan and deliver Ubuntu Server features
  • Work from home with global travel for up to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have 3+ years of experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers. Experience managing distributed teams is a plus.
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills in English
  • You have experience with a modern GNU/Linux distribution; Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Amazon Web Services
What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits reflecting our values and ideals. We balance programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we recruit on a global basis and set a high standard for people joining the company. Canonical has been remote-first since 2004. We expect excellence and strive to be the best at what we do. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination, and we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and perform risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with inspection techniques, non-destructive testing (NDT) methods, and fitness-for-service assessment.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, such as API, ASME, and OSHA.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance in all aspects of work.
  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.
Additional Information
  • Office located in Centro (RJ).
  • Hybrid work regime (after first month everyday at the office).
