Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This role involves leading development of a secure, user‑friendly Linux operating system built on Wayland, MicroVMs and immutability principles and be compatible across diverse devices—from desktops to smart watches. It emphasizes security comparable to Qubes OS through virtualization and compartmentalization, while prioritizing convenience and ease of use. As the lead developer, you will initiate and guide the project from its foundational stages.

Responsibilities
  • Lead and mentor a team of Linux developers, ensuring high code quality, adherence to open source practices, and kernel development standards.
  • Design and implement core OS components, including kernel modifications, user‑space tools, and system integrations for robustness, security, and performance.
  • Collaborate with hardware and security teams to ensure seamless integration and broad device compatibility.
  • Partner with a project manager to define technical roadmaps, prioritize tasks, and achieve project milestones, identifying risks and implementing solutions promptly.
  • Provide hands‑on leadership to bootstrap the project, including initial development, recruiting key personnel, and fostering open source community engagement.
  • Conduct code and architecture reviews to optimize for stability, performance, and hardware compatibility.
  • Stay informed on advancements in the Linux ecosystem, kernel developments, and relevant tools, incorporating innovations as appropriate.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership in Linux distributions, kernel contributions, or related open source projects (e.g., GNOME, systemd).
  • At least 6 years of hands‑on experience in Linux OS development, including kernel programming, distribution packaging, and low‑level system development in C/C++.
  • Proven track record in building open source communities and managing partnerships.
  • Essential experience with immutability (e.g., atomic updates), containerization (e.g., Docker, Podman), virtualization (e.g., QEMU, KVM, Xen for security isolation), Wayland compositing, and cross‑device portability.
  • Strong understanding of operating system principles, security models (e.g., SELinux, AppArmor), and hardware‑software interfaces.
  • Excellent leadership, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
Highly desirable experience
  • Prior experience leading Linux engineering teams and collaborating with open source communities, as well as knowledge of distributed systems or embedded Linux.
Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Membership&Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal
description:
Membership&Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal

Starting Date: ASAP

Contract type: Full-time and open-ended

Salary : R$146,581 commensurate with relevant experience and skills

About the Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose-led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership& Supply ChainOfficer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improving soil health across our network, improving farm income and supporting women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

As Membership & Supply Chain Officer, you will be responsible for supporting members and supply chain actors to achieve their Better Cotton sourcing targets by enabling access to the Better Cotton Platform, delivering insights through reporting, and supporting stakeholder engagement processes, training and events, which contribute to systemic change towards more sustainable cotton production. You will provide high quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team, and support reporting for the region.

Areas that play to your strengths

We are seeking a motivated Membership & Supply Chain Officer to join our Membership and Supply Chain Team.

Membership Engagement & Support
  • Recruit and onboard new members and suppliers.
  • Guide applicants through documentation, cotton consumption calculations, and compliance steps.
  • Maintain member accounts and process applications using Salesforce and assist members with annual cotton consumption reporting.
  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and escalate when needed.
  • Support external communications and awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.
Supply Chain Operations
  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
  • Compile and analyze KPIs (e.g., uptake rates, inventory structures).
  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in-person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.
Reporting & Administration
  • Provide high-quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.
We are looking for someone who has
  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – Excel advanced functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for organizing and delivering online and in-person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication
  • Collaboration and adaptability
  • Problem-solving and attention to detail
  • Time management
  • Power BI or similar tool
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability
  • Initiative and ownership
What we offer
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
  • Continuous learning and development
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Insurance
  • Meal Voucher Allowance
  • 13 th Salary (Bonus) – Paid in 2 instalments Nov/Dec (Additional)
  • Legal protections of Local Labour Law
  • All other Better Cotton Global Policies apply (including enhancements)
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8-9 Bank Holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.
Working arrangements

The position is full-time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply now

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1-page maximum) by or before via this link.

In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human-led assessment experience.

Our hiring process

Initial Screening:

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews:

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.

Assessment and Testing:

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.

Reference Checks:

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.

About Better Cotton

Better Cotton is a global not-for-profit organization supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

About our Values

The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:

  • Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
  • As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
  • Positive (including problem-solving, pragmatic)
  • Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
  • Daring (including courageous, innovative, game-changing)

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.

We have a zero-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição

Join to apply for the Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS role at Triunfo Logística

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para envio de notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para manter os veículos em boas condições e garantir a segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco com base nas atividades das equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer a inspeção de segurança diariamente, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para atender à fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunir as CATs, analisar levantamento de acidentes, calcular horas perdidas e enviar cópias ao Gerente de Filial e à empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e das horas perdidas;
  • Notificar, através de comunicado em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido com simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente;
  • Preencher no site do INSS uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão, local, hora, agente causador, situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador e enviando através do site do INSS;
  • Coordenar a troca ou recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para a Triunfo estar preparada em caso de incêndio;
  • Promover a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, com treinamento total, apresentação via Power Point, palestras em sala de reuniões e apresentando-os aos Supervisores;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno com informações preventivas e atualidades.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades para assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS;
  • Planejar e executar ações para conformidade com requisitos de áreas específicas, como o Porto de Itaguaí, para fins de conformidade.
  • Representar a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar ao Setor de Recursos Humanos;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para assuntos de saúde e higiene, através de reuniões e palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, acompanhar atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, patrimônio e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, seguindo padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar e interpretar exames, diagnosticar e tratar doenças, através da visualização de ossos, órgãos ou estruturas através exames radiológicos e de imagens em geral, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

Título de Especialista em Radiologia

Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - RJ

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

This role is central to that mission: scaling and optimizing our global demand stack, forging strategic relationships with top programmatic buyers, and ensuring sustainable, diversified revenue growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager of Ad Demand Partnerships to dramatically expand and nurture and optimize our programmatic demand partnerships stack. This is a critical, revenue-generating role focused on forging new strategic relationships with global and niche Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs), Supply Side Platforms (SSPs), Ad Networks, and other premium demand partner sources.

Your success will be measured by your ability to increase competition within our ad stack, resulting in higher fill rates and Session RPMs/CPMs for our publishers' inventory across all platforms (web, app, and CTV).

Key Responsibilities Demand Acquisition & Financial Strategy
  • New Partner Sourcing: Proactively identify, prioritize, negotiate, and close new demand partnership agreements with top-tier global and regional advertising platforms (DSPs, Ad Networks, Media Agencies, Trading Desks).
  • Contract Negotiation: Strategically negotiate solid revenue share models and favorable payment terms with demand partners, ad networks that mutually benefit both MonetizeMore and our Publishers.
  • Key Account Focus: Establish and maintain high-level relationships with major programmatic buyers, including companies like The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon, Criteo, and similar companies.
  • Revenue Diversification: Optimize the auction bid pressure from non-Google demand partners to diversify revenue sources for MonetizeMore publishers. Increase the Share of Voice (SOV) from revenue originating from Non-Google Demand to improve our overall revenue diversification.
  • Inventory Expansion: Seek opportunities to add value to our publishers' inventory by targeting local ad agencies that may be interested in buying direct inventory or PMP deals.
  • Media Kit Development: Create a professional solid media kit and compelling pitch materials that will entice demand partners, ad networks, and agencies to buy our inventory.
Technical Integration & Operational Oversight
  • Header Bidding Expertise: Initiate and lead the technical and business integration of new demand partners via MonetizeMore’s proprietary Header Bidding wrapper, ensuring seamless and low-latency performance.
  • Platform Diversification: Drive monetization growth across emerging channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Mobile App Monetization, and other high-growth video environments.
  • Financial Flow Ownership: Take ownership of the payment pipeline and work closely with the Finance Team to ensure demand partner payments are received on time and continue to avoid issues paying our publisher payments are always received on time.

Communication & Reporting
  • High-Impact Communication: Clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business terms to both internal teams and external executive partners.
  • Documentation & Training: Break down complex demand integration processes into simple, clear chunks for internal training and documentation.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends (privacy changes, identity solutions, supply path optimization, etc.) and translate their impact into actionable demand strategies.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years of successful experience in a Demand Partnerships, Business Development, or Supply/Monetization role within the Ad Tech or Publisher space.
  • Industry Knowledge: Solid, expert-level understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including Header Bidding (Prebid), SSPs, DSPs, and Ad Exchanges.
  • Strategic Negotiator: Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial contracts, specifically focusing on revenue share and net payment terms.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of ad demand integration processes, including VAST/VPAID for video, SDKs for app monetization, and general ad serving logic.

description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para profissionais de todas as categorias, obedecendo aos métodos adotados pela Instituição.

Trabalhar conosco é a melhor oportunidade para fazer o que você ama, com desafios constantes e ser reconhecido pelos seus resultados. Responsabilidades
  • Supervisiona e planeja a demanda diária de acordo com o cronograma de entregas estabelecido.   • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;

  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;

Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;

Automation Strategy:
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive testing frameworks and strategies for automated end-to-end tests
  • Ensure consistent automation coverage across products, prioritizing high-value user flows and critical paths
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineering teams to define minimal quality levels and implement continuous testing throughout the SDLC
Quality Assurance Execution:
  • Oversee the design and implementation of reliable automated test scenarios and regression suites using Carta-approved tools, such as Magni framework.
  • Monitor and maintain the health and reliability of automated tests, ensuring they are run consistently within the CI pipeline
  • Analyze defect rates and production incidents to refine testing methodologies
Collaboration and Communication:
  • Foster a culture of quality within engineering teams by advocating for early and consistent testing
  • Provide guidance, consultation, and mentorship to developers on automating tests and using QA tools effectively
  • Empower engineering teams to take ownership of test quality by providing necessary automation, resources, and support
Continuous Improvement:
  • Utilize AI models for automated triage, analysis of failed test runs, and suggesting remediations
  • Develop self-service automation tools and streamline process improvements to enhance developer productivity
  • Track quality metrics and drive progress towards team-specific and company-wide quality goals
About You
  • Proven experience as a QA Manager, with a strong background in automation testing
  • Proficiency in test automation frameworks using Selenium and/or Cypress
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and CI/CD pipeline integrations
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in leading technical teams, with a focus on quality strategy and automation
  • Familiarity with AI-driven testing tools and frameworks
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Your profile

Your profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Membership&Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal
description:
Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal

Starting Date: ASAP
Contract type: Full‑time and open‑ended
Salary: R$146,581 commensurate with relevant experience and skills
Location: Brazil
Application closing date: 27/11/2025

About The Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose‑led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income, and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

Responsibilities
  • Support members and supply chain actors to achieve their Better Cotton sourcing targets by enabling access to the Better Cotton Platform, delivering insights through reporting, and supporting stakeholder engagement process, training and events.
  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team and support reporting for the region.
Membership Engagement & Support
  • Recruit and onboard new members and suppliers.
  • Guide applicants through documentation, cotton consumption calculations, and compliance steps.
  • Maintain member accounts and process applications using Salesforce and assist members with annual cotton consumption reporting.
  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and elevate when needed.
  • Support external communications and raise awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.
Supply Chain Operations
  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
  • Compile and analyze KPIs (e.g., uptake rates, inventory structures).
  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in‑person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.
Reporting & Administration
  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.
Essential
  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – advanced Excel functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for online and in‑person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, adaptability, problem‑solving, attention to detail, and time management.
Desirable
  • Salesforce CRM proficiency.
  • Power BI or similar tool.
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability.
  • Cultural sensitivity.
  • Initiative and ownership.
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary.
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements.
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year.
  • Continuous learning and development.
  • Life insurance, dental insurance, medical insurance, meal voucher allowance.
  • 13th salary (bonus) – paid in 2 installments Nov/Dev.
  • Legal protections of local labour law and all other Better Cotton Global Policies apply.
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8–9 bank holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued.
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.
Working Arrangements

The position is full‑time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply Now

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1 page maximum) by or before via this link. In your cover letter, please explain why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human‑led assessment experience.

Our Hiring Process Initial Screening

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management.

Assessment And Testing

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position.

Reference Checks

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications.

Offer Stage

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If selected, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.

About Better Cotton

Better Cotton is a global not‑for‑profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments, and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand.

About Our Values
  • Trustworthy (honest, transparent, credible).
  • Integrity (responsible, authentic).
  • Positive (problem‑solving, pragmatic).
  • Engaging (adaptable, inclusive, holistic).
  • Daring (courageous, innovative, game‑changing).
Being you @ Better Cotton

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources. We have a zero‑tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI`s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recuperar os danificados, registrar na ficha pessoal do colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;
  • Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais;
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You'll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS)
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties
  • Demonstrates creativity, foresight, and mature engineering judgment in anticipating and solving engineering problems during the development and application of new and improved products and processes.
  • Establishes best practices that incorporate Reliability, Health, Safety, and Environment concepts to guide others in analysis and design.
  • Evaluates proposed theoretical results to meet design requirements.
  • Serves as a technical expert to other employees to solve complex system equations and develops custom equations to simplify complex problems by using advanced engineering tools.
  • Serves as a technical expert by coaching, developing, and reviewing work from other employees.
  • Possesses excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross‑disciplinary teams.
  • Significantly contributes to Halliburton’s Intellectual Property portfolio by delivering innovative and commercially successful solutions.
  • Work across multiple teams located in different countries (Brazil, US, Singapore, India).
  • Work close to the Electrical Engineering team, Systems Engineer, and the Project Manager at the Halliburton Technology Center in Brazil (HBTC).
Qualifications
  • Completion of a master’s or doctoral degree in Electrical Engineering or similar discipline is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • 5 years of experience in R&D.
  • Experience with multidisciplinary teams located in different locations/countries.
  • Experience in design of complex systems solutions including several engineering disciplines for Oil & Gas, mining and/or aerospace industry.
  • Experience in design solutions for subsea applications and well control involving multi disciplines.
  • Experience in design solutions for well intervention applications involving multi disciplines is desirable.
  • Ability to provide guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers as needed.
  • Experience defining requirements and reviewing proposals from third party (manufacturers, vendors, and suppliers).

  • Knowledge and experience in Risk Assessment, FMEA, other reliability tools.
  • Advanced experience with design, simulation, development, implementation, verification, and validation of power electronic based systems/solutions.
  • Troubleshooting of power electronics and proficiency in using lab equipment.
  • Knowledge of communication systems/solutions (data compression and transmission).
  • Advanced working knowledge in electronic circuit design and in commonly used circuit simulators (LTSPICE, PSPICE, etc.) and math tools (Matlab, MathCAD, etc.) applied to embedded systems in harsh environments (O&G, mining or aerospace).
  • Knowledge in power systems demands (Batteries / Recharge / Power management / Passivation / Ramp up / Shut down).
